Unique bin visit patterns by cow

Source: R/data.R
bin_visits.Rd

A dataset containing the unique bin visit patterns for each cow across the three-day period (2020-10-31 to 2020-11-02). This dataset is the result of applying the unique_bin_visits() function to the quality-checked feeding and drinking data.

Usage

bin_visits

Format

A data frame with the following variables:

date

Date, calendar date of the records

cow

integer, animal ID number

unique_feed_bins_visited

integer, number of unique feed bins visited by the cow on that day

unique_water_bins_visited

integer, number of unique water bins visited by the cow on that day

total_bins_visited

integer, total number of unique bins (feed + water) visited by the cow on that day

Source

Generated by applying unique_bin_visits() to clean_feed and clean_water

Details

This dataset quantifies the exploratory behavior of each cow by counting how many different feeding and drinking stations they visited on each day. Cows with higher values tend to be more exploratory, visiting many different bins, while those with lower values may be more habitual, preferring to use fewer bins consistently.

Examples

# Calculate average number of unique bins visited per cow
avg_bins <- aggregate(total_bins_visited ~ cow, bin_visits, mean)

# Find the most exploratory cow (visits the most unique bins)
most_exploratory <- avg_bins[which.max(avg_bins$total_bins_visited), ]
most_exploratory
#>     cow total_bins_visited
#> 27 6030                 32
